If you are married filing a joint return, the spouse who received the qualified tips must have a valid SSN." When that condition fails, Part II is not filled out, so line 12 is a skipped line (adjudication README: a nonzero amount on a line the source says to skip, on a reachable return, is a defect of the side producing it; the project encodes a skipped line as zero). The project prints line 12 only when Part II applies (s1a.part2); the candidate figures it on every return. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1a.json; 1,083 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 111 partial records): 899 of 1694 comparisons agree; differences: 404 candidate-refuses, 258 value, 131 project-unknown, 2 candidate-unknown; witnesses (project / candidate): candidate-refuses e.g. classm.w2.1.deepseek ($0.00 / refusal), classm.f8889.4.deepseek ($0.00 / refusal); value e.g. classm.f8889.2.deepseek ($0.00 / $8,400.00), classm.f4562.1 ($0.00 / $35,600.00); project-unknown e.g. classm.f4952.1 (unknown s1a.tips / $23,800.00), classm.f4952.2 (unknown s1a.tips / $34,800.00); candidate-unknown e.g. stage16.cleanup.refuse.f2441_line24 ($0.00 / unknown person[spouse].sav_trad), ss.mfs ($0.00 / unknown sb.unsupported). Host re-check of all 258 value records: s1a.part2 is false on every one. Reachable witness (full interview, canonical/2025/interview-full.json): 34 of the 107 interview-complete generated returns have s1a.part2 false and a nonzero candidate line 12, for example generated 20261026/5 (single; project $0.00 / candidate $60000.00). No later amount changes, because line 7 is $0 there, so line 13 is $0 on both sides, but under the README rule the nonzero skipped line is itself the defect. The unknown-kind records are not interview-producible: the full interview (canonical/2025/interview-full.json) reaches f1040.line13b = s1a.line38 on every return, and project lines 13, 21 and 30 read s1a.tips, s1a.overtime and s1a.carloan first, so those answers are always asked; the records lacking them are fixtures written for other forms (hundreds of unknown lines each) and partials that withhold them. Host re-check (read-only re-evaluation of the same bank, outside the triage record): every refusal-kind record, and every other unknown-kind record, is on a return that both runtimes refuse elsewhere (f1040.line11b and the sb, sd, eic, f2441 or s3.mfs refusals; married filing separately is refused for the whole return through s3.mfs in scope.yaml and s3.line11).

If you are married filing jointly, the spouse who received the qualified overtime compensation must have a valid SSN." and i1040gi p. 108, line 14a with the Qualified Overtime Compensation From More Than One Employer Worksheet. Both sides sum person.ot_total over people with a valid SSN, gated on s1a.overtime and not married filing separately. The project also tests s1a.ot_ssn, which the work_ssn filter already implies for the amount. The two candidate-unknown records lack s1a.overtime (classm.sb.2, and the partial classm.sa.3 without s1a.overtime), and both are refused by both runtimes. The unknown-kind records are not interview-producible: the full interview (canonical/2025/interview-full.json) reaches f1040.line13b = s1a.line38 on every return, and project lines 13, 21 and 30 read s1a.tips, s1a.overtime and s1a.carloan first, so those answers are always asked; the records lacking them are fixtures written for other forms (hundreds of unknown lines each) and partials that withhold them. Host re-check (read-only re-evaluation of the same bank, outside the triage record): every refusal-kind record, and every other unknown-kind record, is on a return that both runtimes refuse elsewhere (f1040.line11b and the sb, sd, eic, f2441 or s3.mfs refusals; married filing separately is refused for the whole return through s3.mfs in scope.yaml and s3.line11).

The candidate's line 14a reads the worksheet roster $otjob (person.ot_total) on every return with no s1a.overtime or Part gate, although s1a.overtime is in its interface and it tests it on its deduction line.
